message: The list now owns the saved Apollo cache (persistence/**, CacheRestoreGate/**) to stop one person's data reaching the next user, but the code that wipes that data on sign-out (src/lib/clearSessionData.ts) and the service worker rules that keep token-bearing and donor responses out of the browser cache (src/sw/**, src/lib/serviceWorker/**) are outside both lists, so the bot can approve a change that leaves the last user's data behind.
"Add or remove a path in both files together, not here. It covers:" now ends on "here", so "It" reads as CLAUDE.md instead of the CODEOWNERS list.
The new header comment runs 4 lines and the .claude carve-out comment runs 3, longer than the one-to-two-line comment rule.
